data.narrative:
Skydio, a Series F autonomous systems company in Defense & Security, carries a post-money valuation of $4.4B following $825M+ in total capital raised. The valuation is benchmarked against a peer set of 18 same-sector companies at similar valuation tiers, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), Shield AI ($12.7B, Series G), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.3x step-up multiplier typical of Series F advancement to the $4.4B base, yielding $5.7B. Peer-median analysis across 18 Defense & Security comparables yields $2.4B, with an observed range of $1.0B to $18.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage, revenue scale, and product maturity across the sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $2.0B (low) to $6.6B (high), with a median of $4.0B. The current $4.4B valuation sits modestly above the median, positioning Skydio in the upper half of its peer distribution. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory relative to later-stage Defense & Security incumbents, contract concentration risk, and regulatory pathway clarity in autonomous systems procurement. The stage-progression method implies upside to $5.7B contingent on Series G momentum; peer-median compression suggests downside risk if comparable valuations contract.
